story.title: A house of considered gifting
story.body1: The right gift never depends on price — it depends on the moment. A birthday calls for something a little indulgent, while a sympathy gift needs to feel gentle and considered. Thank-you gifts, baby gifts, anniversary and corporate gifts each ask for their own tone, and getting that tone right is what makes a gift memorable.
story.body2: Velvea organises everything by occasion, recipient and gifting style, so you can browse classic gourmet baskets, chocolate gifts, wine pairings, wellness picks and fully custom baskets. Every basket is backed by one promise: only genuinely good products make it in, and each one arrives exactly as it appeared online.
story.corpBody: Corporate gifting works best when it feels professional and thoughtful without becoming a project. Velvea supports client appreciation, employee recognition, workplace milestones and year-end programmes — every corporate hamper curated to reflect the standard your business holds itself to.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.lede: Everything you need to know about ordering and delivery.

items.q: Do you deliver gift baskets across Canada?
items.a: Yes. Velvea offers gift basket delivery across Canada, with same-day delivery available in Mississauga and the GTA on eligible orders. Delivery availability and timing may vary by product and destination.

items.q: Is same-day delivery available in Mississauga and the GTA?
items.a: Yes — order by 4 PM for same-day delivery on eligible orders within Mississauga and the Greater Toronto Area.

items.q: Do you offer corporate gift baskets?
items.a: Absolutely. We support bulk orders, branded notes, custom messaging and multi-address delivery. Request a corporate quote and our team will build a programme around your needs.

items.q: Can I customize a gift basket?
items.a: Yes. Use our Custom Basket builder to choose a container and hand-pick what goes inside, or contact us for a fully bespoke order.

items.q: Are your gift baskets pre-made or packed to order?
items.a: Every basket is packed to order after you purchase, hand-finished and arranged to arrive exactly as it appeared online.

items.q: Which Canadian cities do you deliver to?
items.a: We ship to every province and territory, including Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Toronto, Ottawa, Montréal and Halifax, with local same-day service across the GTA.
